courses.title: SAP Fundamentals
courses.description: Introduction to SAP ERP systems. Covers SAP architecture, navigation, basic transactions, and the organizational structure of SAP modules. Ideal for absolute beginners with no SAP experience.

courses.title: SAP Financial Accounting (FI) Basics
courses.description: Core SAP FI module covering general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and asset accounting. Learn to post financial transactions and generate basic financial reports in SAP.

courses.title: SAP Controlling (CO) Fundamentals
courses.description: SAP CO module essentials including cost center accounting, internal orders, profitability analysis, and cost element accounting. Understand how CO integrates with FI for management reporting.

courses.title: SAP FICO Advanced Integration
courses.description: Advanced integration between SAP FI and CO modules. Covers cross-module postings, automatic account determination, real-time integration scenarios, and complex financial closing processes.

courses.title: SAP S/4HANA Migration Essentials
courses.description: Planning and executing migration from SAP ECC to S/4HANA. Covers migration approaches (greenfield, brownfield, selective data transition), data migration tools, and post-migration validation.

courses.title: SAP Materials Management (MM)
courses.description: SAP MM module covering procurement processes, inventory management, invoice verification, and material master data. Learn purchase order creation, goods receipt, and vendor evaluation.

courses.title: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD)
courses.description: Complete SAP SD module training including sales order processing, pricing, billing, shipping, and credit management. Understand the order-to-cash cycle in SAP.

courses.title: SAP Consultant Certification Prep
courses.description: Comprehensive preparation for SAP certification exams. Covers exam strategies, practice questions across FI, CO, MM, and SD modules, and real-world case study analysis.

courses.title: Workday HCM Foundations
courses.description: Introduction to Workday Human Capital Management. Covers Workday architecture, tenant structure, core HCM concepts, worker data management, and basic reporting.

courses.title: Workday Business Processes
courses.description: Deep dive into Workday business process configuration. Covers process definitions, approval chains, condition rules, notifications, and business process security.

courses.title: Workday Compensation and Benefits
courses.description: Configure and manage compensation plans, benefit plans, and open enrollment in Workday. Covers compensation eligibility rules, merit cycles, and benefits administration.

courses.title: Workday Advanced Reporting and Analytics
courses.description: Advanced Workday reporting including composite reports, matrix reports, calculated fields, dashboard creation, and Workday Prism Analytics integration.

courses.title: Workday Integration and Studio
courses.description: Build integrations using Workday Studio, EIBs, and cloud connectors. Covers XSLT transformations, web service endpoints, and integration event monitoring.

courses.title: Workday Payroll Administration
courses.description: End-to-end Workday payroll processing including payroll input, calculation, settlement, and reporting. Covers tax configuration, retro adjustments, and payroll accounting.

courses.title: Salesforce Platform Basics
courses.description: Introduction to the Salesforce platform. Covers CRM fundamentals, Salesforce architecture, standard objects (Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities), basic customization, and the AppExchange.

courses.title: Salesforce Administration Essentials
courses.description: Core Salesforce admin skills including user management, security model, profiles and permission sets, data management, workflow rules, and process builder automation.

courses.title: Salesforce Data Modeling and Management
courses.description: Custom object creation, relationships, schema design, data import/export, duplicate management, and data quality best practices in Salesforce.

courses.title: Salesforce Flow and Automation
courses.description: Advanced automation using Salesforce Flow Builder. Covers screen flows, record-triggered flows, scheduled flows, approval processes, and best practices for scalable automation.

courses.title: Salesforce Reports and Dashboards
courses.description: Build powerful reports and dashboards in Salesforce. Covers report types, filters, groupings, formulas, cross-filters, joined reports, and dashboard components with dynamic filtering.

courses.title: Salesforce Administrator Certification Prep
courses.description: Comprehensive preparation for the Salesforce Administrator certification exam. Covers all exam objectives with practice questions, scenario-based exercises, and timed mock exams.

courses.title: Salesforce Lightning Experience Customization
courses.description: Customize the Lightning Experience with Lightning App Builder, custom components, dynamic forms, Lightning pages, and guided action lists.

courses.title: Salesforce Service Cloud
courses.description: Implement Service Cloud features including case management, knowledge base, omni-channel routing, entitlements, service console, and customer community portals.

courses.title: Cloud Computing Fundamentals
courses.description: Introduction to cloud computing concepts. Covers IaaS, PaaS, SaaS models, cloud deployment types, virtualization basics, and an overview of major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).

courses.title: AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials
courses.description: AWS fundamentals covering core services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda), AWS global infrastructure, pricing models, shared responsibility model, and basic AWS security.

courses.title: AWS Solutions Architect Associate
courses.description: Design resilient, high-performing, secure, and cost-optimized architectures on AWS. Covers VPC, IAM, ELB, Auto Scaling, CloudFormation, and multi-tier application design.

courses.title: AWS DevOps and CI/CD
courses.description: Implement continuous integration and delivery on AWS using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, and CloudFormation. Covers infrastructure as code, monitoring, and deployment strategies.

courses.title: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
courses.description: Microsoft Azure cloud concepts, core services, security, privacy, compliance, pricing, and support. Prepares for the AZ-900 certification exam.

courses.title: Azure Administrator (AZ-104)
courses.description: Manage Azure subscriptions, implement storage solutions, configure virtual networking, manage identities, and monitor Azure resources. Prepares for AZ-104 certification.

courses.title: Kubernetes and Container Orchestration
courses.description: Deploy and manage containerized applications with Kubernetes. Covers pods, services, deployments, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Helm charts, and cluster administration on AWS EKS and Azure AKS.

courses.title: Cloud Architecture Design Patterns
courses.description: Learn proven cloud architecture patterns: microservices, event-driven architecture, CQRS, saga pattern, circuit breaker, and serverless patterns. Apply to multi-cloud scenarios.

courses.title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
courses.description: Foundational AI concepts including machine learning types (supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement), neural network basics, AI ethics, and real-world AI applications across industries.

courses.title: Python for Data Science and ML
courses.description: Python programming for AI/ML workflows. Covers NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn basics, data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation techniques.

courses.title: Machine Learning Algorithms Deep Dive
courses.description: In-depth study of ML algorithms: linear/logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, SVMs, k-means clustering, and ensemble methods. Includes mathematical foundations and implementation.

courses.title: Deep Learning with TensorFlow and PyTorch
courses.description: Build and train deep neural networks using TensorFlow and PyTorch. Covers CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, transfer learning, model optimization, and GPU training strategies.

courses.title: Natural Language Processing (NLP)
courses.description: NLP techniques including text preprocessing, word embeddings (Word2Vec, GloVe), sequence models, attention mechanisms, transformers, and BERT/GPT fine-tuning for text tasks.

courses.title: MLOps and Model Deployment
courses.description: Operationalize ML models with MLOps practices. Covers model versioning, experiment tracking (MLflow), containerized deployment, A/B testing, model monitoring, and drift detection.

courses.title: Generative AI and LLM Applications
courses.description: Build applications with Large Language Models. Covers prompt engineering, RAG architectures, LangChain, fine-tuning strategies, AI agents, and responsible AI deployment.

courses.title: Computer Vision Fundamentals
courses.description: Image classification, object detection (YOLO, SSD), image segmentation, GANs for image generation, and practical computer vision projects using OpenCV and deep learning frameworks.

courses.title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
courses.description: Introduction to cybersecurity principles. Covers CIA triad, common threat types, basic cryptography, network security concepts, security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001), and security awareness.

courses.title: Network Security and Firewalls
courses.description: Network security essentials including TCP/IP security, firewall configuration, IDS/IPS systems, VPN technologies, network segmentation, and wireless security protocols.

courses.title: Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing
courses.description: Learn ethical hacking methodologies. Covers reconnaissance, scanning, exploitation, post-exploitation, Kali Linux tools, Metasploit, web application testing (OWASP Top 10), and reporting.

courses.title: Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst
courses.description: SOC operations including SIEM tools (Splunk, ELK), log analysis, incident detection, alert triage, threat intelligence feeds, and incident response procedures.

courses.title: Cloud Security Architecture
courses.description: Secure cloud environments on AWS and Azure. Covers identity management, encryption, key management, security groups, WAF, DDoS protection, and compliance in cloud contexts.

courses.title: Incident Response and Digital Forensics
courses.description: Handle security incidents from detection to recovery. Covers forensic imaging, evidence preservation, malware analysis, memory forensics, chain of custody, and post-incident review.

courses.title: Application Security (AppSec)
courses.description: Secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC). Covers secure coding practices, SAST/DAST tools, dependency scanning, container security, DevSecOps, and threat modeling.

courses.title: CompTIA Security+ Certification Prep
courses.description: Comprehensive preparation for CompTIA Security+ certification. Covers all exam domains: threats, vulnerabilities, architecture, operations, incident response, and governance/compliance.

courses.title: Workday Talent Management
courses.description: Configure performance management, succession planning, career development, and talent reviews in Workday. Covers talent cards, calibration, and learning integration.

courses.title: Workday Pro Certification Prep
courses.description: Prepare for Workday Pro certification covering HCM, business processes, reporting, security, and integration. Includes practice exams and real-world configuration scenarios.

courses.title: Serverless Computing on AWS
courses.description: Build serverless applications using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, and EventBridge. Covers serverless design patterns, cold starts, and cost optimization.

courses.title: AWS Solutions Architect Professional
courses.description: Advanced AWS architecture for complex, multi-account, hybrid environments. Covers advanced networking, migration strategies, cost optimization at scale, and disaster recovery planning.
